title: B2B outbound benchmarks
description: First-party datasets on B2B cold email outcomes by recipient mail provider (327,273 contacted leads, 97 campaigns), the receiving mail provider for about 10.2M domains in B2B contact data, a cold email reply-rate benchmark (429,763 sends), B2B lead generation prices, price history and contract terms for 14 providers, and in-house seller cost for the US and Canada from government wage data. Each dataset's method, denominators and limitations are published on its source page at replylead.com.
